proposal.summary: Authenticated command injection in the Comtrend VR-3033 router's diagnostic Ping and Traceroute web interface allows command execution via the pingIpAddress parameter, demonstrated by injecting ';ls' and receiving directory listing output.
proposal.cwe_quote:
on the text input, type 'google.fr;ls - l'
5 - a list of folder names should appear.

C.quote: 5 - a list of folder names should appear.

I.quote: 5 - a list of folder names should appear.

A.quote: 5 - a list of folder names should appear.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request firmware confirmation and vendor fix; obtain vulnerable device or firmware to reproduce and identify exact command execution impact, then develop and verify a vendor patch or mitigation (sanitize input or restrict diagnostic commands to admin only).
